meaning.evidence: All facts survive: 1/4 point rise to 3-3/4 to 4 percent, ample reserves, unemployment steady, solid growth, inflation above 2 percent, the directive and statement verbatim, the twelve voters, IORB 3.90 percent, primary credit 4.0 percent, next meeting October 27-28, adjournment 10:15 a.m., notation vote of August 18.

sense.evidence: Mostly exact ("bump the target range ... up", "hadn't budged much", "running too hot", "The meeting knocked off at 10:15 a.m."), but "doubled down on the FOMC's policy" overstates "reaffirmed" (it implies escalating a risky bet).

authenticity.evidence: Natural in the narrated parts: "When the yakking wrapped up", "Not a single bugger.", "the Committee's next get-together". A few lines are pasted-on idiom ("the whole lot of members").

register.evidence: The narration is level 4 with dad-level swearing ("Not a single bugger."), but the directive and the statement (about half the text) are left word for word, so overall it is lighter than asked.

tone.evidence: The official record's seriousness stays in the quoted blocks; the narration is breezier but keeps the facts straight.

flow.evidence: Narration reads well; the switch between yarn and untouched Fed-speak is abrupt.

variety.evidence: Varied in the parts it retells: "bump", "doubled down", "running too hot", "crystal clear", "dead set", "yakking", "signing off", "knocked off", "thumbs-up".

essence.evidence: Recognisably the minutes; the untouched quoted documents keep it close, but it reads half-retold.

problems.original: Undertake open market operations as necessary to maintain the federal funds rate in a target range of 3-3/4 to 4 percent.
problems.why: Representative of the directive and statement left untranslated, short of a level-4 brief.

problems.quote: doubled down on the FOMC's policy
the whole lot of members agreed
problems.why: Clunky; "the whole lot of 'em" or "every member" would be natural.

A.summary: Good, natural retelling of the narrative parts, with the quoted directive and statement left untouched, so it falls short of level 4.

meaning.evidence: Facts are garbled: "all members gave raise the target range the nod", "inflation remained elevated rello to", "its continuing swear blind to achieve", and a voter's name split as "Lorie K. Anyway, Logan".

sense.evidence: Many wrong senses: "rello" (relative, the family member) for "relative to", "swear blind" for "resolve", "said righto" inside an official vote.

authenticity.evidence: Stage-Australian tags bolted on: "Well, bugger me, at the conclusion of the discussion", "Crikey, Productivity growth is strong", "Now, the Committee".

register.evidence: Swearing within dad level, but mostly untouched Fed text with stray tags; far from level 4.

tone.evidence: Official minutes punctured by random exclamations ("Crikey,").

flow.evidence: Broken grammar and joins: "gave raise the target range the nod", "adjourned at 10:15 a.m. Now, on September 16, 2026."

variety.evidence: A few filler tags ("Well,", "Now,", "Anyway,") and swaps.

essence.evidence: The structure is there, but the content is defaced, including a voter's name.

problems.why: A filler tag inserted inside a voter's name corrupts the voting record.

problems.quote: gave raise the target range the nod
problems.original: agreed to raise the target range
problems.why: Ungrammatical; the decision becomes hard to read.

problems.quote: elevated rello to the Committee's 2 percent goal
problems.original: elevated relative to the Committee's 2 percent goal

problems.quote: its continuing swear blind to achieve
problems.why: "swear blind" is a verb phrase for insisting, not a noun for resolve.

problems.quote: The meeting adjourned at 10:15 a.m. Now, on September 16, 2026.
problems.original: The meeting adjourned at 10:15 a.m. on September 16, 2026.
problems.why: Tag dropped mid-sentence, breaking the date.

B.summary: A broken word-swap pass that garbles the record, down to a voter's name.

meaning.evidence: Every fact and figure survives through the directive and statement too: "a cap of $160 billion per counterparty per day", "3 years or less left to run", 12-0, IORB 3.90 percent, primary credit 4.0 percent, dates and times. Asides ("No word of a lie, here's how it went down.", "Back to work, the lot of 'em.") are colour.

sense.evidence: Terms fit: "gave the nod to lifting", "chugging along nicely", "a solid clip", "businesses are splashing out on investment", "Not a single knocker in the room."

authenticity.evidence: Sounds like an Aussie retelling the minutes: "every member around the table gave the nod", "putting it in black and white", "said righto".

register.evidence: Level 4 throughout, including the quoted documents; no swearing beyond dad level (none needed).

tone.evidence: Keeps the facts and the firmness ("The Committee will deliver price stability."), though the opener and "Back to work, the lot of 'em." add a cheekiness the record lacks; within the voice change the brief asks.

flow.evidence: Reads smoothly from start to finish.

variety.evidence: Varied: "gave the nod", "stuck by", "chugging along", "crystal clear", "dead set", "black and white", "solid clip", "splashing out", "hardly budged", "knocker", "righto".

essence.evidence: Unmistakably the FOMC minutes, fully retold.
